name: screen-recorder
description: Personal screen recorder with Screen Studio-style motion

scripts.dist:win: npm run build:recorder && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:recorder: cd native/win-recorder && cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu && cd ../.. && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('native/bin',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('native/win-recorder/target/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/release/recorder.exe','native/bin/recorder.exe')"
scripts.build:recorder:native: cd native/win-recorder && cargo build --release && cd ../.. && node -e "require('fs').mkdirSync('native/bin',{recursive:true});require('fs').copyFileSync('native/win-recorder/target/release/recorder.exe','native/bin/recorder.exe')"
scripts.dist:win:native: npm run build:recorder:native && node scripts/build.mjs && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never
